information.description:
Rumored ex-corp solos or enforcers from the south. Deadly, heavily chromed, fast and hard to hit.

Valentinos: Heywood's Latino gang, all gold, faith and family.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

Contains: Neural Link (5 Neuralware slots, none used by the rest), Holophone, Biomonitor, Virtu (virtual experiences; full immersion when deep diving), HUD (labels, transcripts, subtitles; shown in any cybereye, replacing the Chyron), two Shard Slots (chipware sockets) and a Personal Link (pull-out interface plug). Has a basic firewall (Chapter 10 of the Core Rules).

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +1 REF by 1 point for the duration
  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 REF unless under the Primary Effect
  • GM will tell you when when you crave more Synthcoke. Roleplay accordingly.

Throwing a grenade, or anything else you can lob. A Ranged Attack with Athletics (DEX) at up to 25m/yds on the DV Thrown Weapon table; anyone who can Dodge bullets can Dodge it.

Grenades: equip it and load a grenade, the way you load a gun; the throw uses the grenade up. The grenade decides the damage: 6d6 unless it says otherwise.
